subject: Evaris AP: vendor onboarding checklist & PO requirements
messages:
From: Sofia Delgado <sofia.delgado@evarispharma.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@evarispharma.com>
Date: 2026-11-21 08:12 +01:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding — required docs & PO fields

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our AP team is ready to register Redwood Inference in Evaris' vendor master. Attached is our standard vendor requirements packet (Evaris_AP_Vendor_Reqs_2026-11-21.pdf) and a checklist of mandatory PO fields. Key asks from AP: 

- Official company legal name and VAT/Tax ID (for EU VAT validation)
- Registered address and remit-to banking instructions (SEPA-friendly)
- W9/W8 equivalent (if applicable) or EU VAT confirmation
- Contact for invoicing and dispute handling (name + email + phone)
- Example invoice showing line-item and VAT breakdown
- Supplier portal login contact (they will create the vendor profile once we return the completed packet)

They also require the PO number on the invoice and a specific GL code: EV-GL-991. Please confirm whether you can accept 30-day net terms and if you need any alternative billing cadence.

Can you please return the completed vendor packet and a sample invoice by EOD Tuesday? Procurement will create the vendor record once they receive the PDF and bank details.

Thanks,
Sofia Delgado
AP Manager — Evaris Pharma
sofia.delgado@evarispharma.com
+44 20 7946 1122

Folks — attaching the invoice template we use for EU customers (Invoice_Template_EU.xlsx). Notes: 

- Put PO number in the header field labeled 'Customer PO#' and EV-GL-991 in the memo or GL code column.
- VAT should be shown as a separate line with the rate and amount (we can issue VAT-exempt invoices for customers with valid reverse-charge setups but Evaris appears to need VAT numbers for their records).
- For SEPA transfers, include IBAN and BIC in the bottom-left of the invoice; bank will accept EUR.
- If they insist on Net 30, we can accept but propose 2%/15 early-pay discount — Marissa, flag if that needs a pricing amendment.

I'll fill the invoice example with DEAL-7832 values and send to Olga to include in the completed packet.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Finance — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: Invoice_Template_EU.xlsx

- Completed vendor registration form (Completed_Vendor_Form.pdf) — legal name, VAT ID, registered address.
- Sample invoice filled for DEAL-7832 showing line items, VAT breakdown, and EV-GL-991.
- SEPA banking sheet (Redwood_BankDetails_SEPA.xlsx) with IBAN/BIC and beneficiary details.
- Requested payment terms: Net 45 or Net 30 with 2%/15 early-pay discount (please advise which will be used on the PO).

A couple of clarifying asks from our side: 
- Please confirm the vendor portal email you will use so we can accept the invitation.
- Confirm whether you will create a single vendor record for Redwood Inference, Inc. or if you require a separate record for our EU billing entity (Redwood EMEA Ltd).
- Final PO number to reference on the invoice once procurement issues it.

We can also accept invoices via your supplier portal or via AP@redwood.ai if that simplifies submission.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov

Redwood Inference
